question: Astronomers have proposed a strange kind of star that would have an entire neutron star buried deep inside its core.

question: Kamoʻoalewa is a small 'quasi-moon' that travels alongside Earth as it orbits the Sun. Where is it now thought to have come from?
choices: A captured comet from the outer Solar System
A fragment blasted off the Moon
A leftover chunk from the formation of Mars
A piece of a shattered asteroid from the main belt
anchorText: indicate that it is likely lunar ejecta

question: The distant dwarf planet Quaoar surprised astronomers because its ring does what?
choices: Circles the dwarf planet from pole to pole, not around its equator
Is so close in that it should have been torn apart long ago
Orbits far outside the distance where rings were thought able to survive
Is denser and more massive than the dwarf planet itself
anchorText: two thin rings orbiting outside its Roche limit

question: When food runs short, the marine iguana can actually shrink — becoming measurably shorter in body length — and then grow back again once food returns.
anchorText: Some individuals have been shown to shrink in body size

question: A German city has run a railway since 1901 in which the carriages hang underneath the rail instead of riding on top of it.

question: In the 1950s some buses ran with no engine and no overhead trolley wire — propelled entirely by a heavy flywheel that was spun up with electricity at each stop.
